errors.text_span: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt die Entwicklung des Bruttoinlandsprodukts (BIP) in Prozent für verschiedene europäische Länder
errors.evidence: The chart does not show the development of GDP; it shows government expenditures as a percentage of GDP.

errors.text_span: Die horizontale Achse repräsentiert den Wert in Prozent des BIP, mit einer Skala von 0 bis 4, wobei die Beschriftungen in Schritten von 1 angegeben sind
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis has intervals of 0.5, not 1.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind horizontal angeordnet, wobei die blauen und grünen Segmente nebeneinander liegen, wobei der grüne Teil rechts vom blauen Teil beginnt
errors.evidence: The bars are stacked, not side-by-side. The green segment is stacked on top of the blue segment.

errors.text_span: Die Länge der Balken variiert zwischen etwa 0,7 % für Spanien und 4,1 % für Polen
errors.evidence: The total bar length for Spain is closer to 1.5%, not 0.7%, and for Poland, it is closer to 3.5%, not 4.1%.
The description does not mention that the chart illustrates government expenditures as a percentage of GDP for European countries.
The description does not mention the linear scale of the horizontal axis or the intervals of 0.5.
The description does not mention the legend explaining the blue and green segments or the black line indicating 1.5% above the reference value of 2021.
The description does not mention the specific countries with the highest and lowest expenditures, such as Poland having the longest bar and Spain having one of the shortest.
